description:
Reports rating progress and, once available, the quote options. status is one of:
  - running: prices are still arriving; check again in a turn or two.
  - quoted: options are ready. While finishing.active is true, Libertas is still capturing exact rates, so ranges are estimates (the final number may land within or below the range, but that isn't guaranteed); check back later. Options marked 'verified' are exact, bindable numbers.
  - needs_data: carriers need more information first. needs.prompts lists each item, who it's for, and the update_quote field to set; apply the customer's answers, then call get_quote_options again. When needs.secure_link is present, that item (a driver's license number) is entered on Libertas's secure page instead of in chat: share the link with the customer, and rates re-run automatically once they submit it.
  - timeout or error: offer to try again with get_quote_options.
Carriers appear as 'Home Carrier A', 'Auto Carrier B', and so on; the real carrier name is shown on Libertas's secure bind page.

max_options.description: Maximum options to return per line (1-5, default 3).

quote_id.description: The quote session id to poll.

name: check_quote_status

outputSchema.description: Live rating status plus masked options (carriers hidden until the bind step). Status 'needs_data' means the customer must supply the fields in `needs.prompts` (apply via update_quote, then re-run get_quote_options).

title: Check quote status
